blockers.quote: Can this spread? You don't know. You don't know how you got it.
blockers.why: No new power rule after the halfway point: after the stadium's five-second hold, the possibility that the sight spreads lands just after the roughly 3:55 midpoint, yet the ending depends on it.
blockers.fix: Move this exact line to after line 222, before the midpoint. Keep the stadium stranger as its silent payoff and delete the line here.

blockers.quote: The host puts you side by side.
blockers.why: Check #11, Never say the feeling: this only repeats the immediately preceding SCENE direction and turns no value.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "Now the test turns on you."

blockers.quote: The lift goes. You say it anyway, to an empty floor. Fine. Nothing clicks. Yours never clicks for you.
blockers.why: Check #22, A laugh in every scene: this is a second plainly sad beat in addition to the dishes scene, and the empty-floor scene has no laugh.
blockers.fix: Restage it as a printer callback: the colleague says, "Printer's fixed." Click. The doors close as the printer jams and spits out half a page. Keep your "Fine" and unseen counter, then replace this line with: "One last click. Just not yours."

suggestions.quote: At lunch you find out what it's worth outside.
suggestions.fix: Strengthen the causal bridge: "Making your boss tell the truth saves the deadline. So at lunch, you test what the counter can save you outside."

suggestions.quote: You take the table in an hour anyway. Nobody will deal to you again.
suggestions.fix: Let the quiet player win one pot before you adapt and take the table, so trying and learning—not the power alone—earn the result.
